notes:
Native google-genai passthrough on Vertex AI: request.json is the raw body a google-genai client sends to the gateway's /v1beta/models/{model}:{action} route; the gateway resolves the model to a provider configured for Vertex AI and doGenAIRequest / StreamGenerateContent relay it to the publisher-model URL (.../v1beta1/projects/

/locations//publishers/google/models/:), returning the upstream status and body untouched. countTokens is relayed byte for byte and nothing is parsed or billed. The body is the v1beta1 CountTokensResponse (aiplatform v1beta1 discovery, revision 20261012: totalTokens, totalBillableCharacters, promptTokensDetails; Vertex AI has no cachedContentTokenCount here, unlike the Gemini API); googleapis/go-genai models.go countTokensResponseFromVertex reads totalTokens. totalBillableCharacters counts the prompt's non-whitespace characters; whether a Gemini 3.8 model still reports it is unverified until a recording. Recordable through cmd/contract-recorder's Vertex AI upstream (VERTEX_PROJECT and VERTEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, optional VERTEX_LOCATION); the scheduled jobs skip vertex@ models, because the access token lasts an hour, so record it locally.
